assessment_scope: Complete proposal against user intent, Constitution, Vision and its cited ownership/operational/code basis. Formal-lifecycle/manual; PRR1G-recorded-context-gated.
independence_basis: User-authorized separate reviewer agent proposal-reviewer did not author or edit the contribution authored by root; it independently inspected the complete proposal and cited basis.
limitations: Direction-level review only; exact retirement inventory, compatibility, implementation, suite parallel safety and performance remain unproved downstream work.
Manual isolated assessment does not start Design, update activity, grant external permissions or establish final verification/branch readiness.
rationale: Challenge and goals: pass. Fragmented criteria and execution authority cause maintenance burden; consolidation, independence, concurrency and actual cleanup directly address it.

Scope and scope preservation: pass. All user goals remain explicit: one Validation owner merging Test and execution, independent tests and bounded parallelism, no validation cache, and removal of superseded designs/scripts/exclusive machinery. Consumer reconciliation is a same-slice dependency; unrelated cleanup and dependency-download caches are excluded. scope_budget_context applies and passes the explicit treatment/boundary table. No hidden deferral. vision_exception_context and standing_artifact_context are false; no trigger ambiguity.

Governing principle and direction: pass. A single necessary contract combines proof quality and execution while product invariants, Delivery allocation, assessment/applicability, recording and operational permissions retain their owners.

Feasibility: pass. Exactly one embedded Feasibility section supplies assessment, evidence and constraints without an unresolved proposal-level blocker. Test already defines TEST-SR-01 through TEST-SR-14 (the latter scoped to its selected cleanup); System identifies operational sources. Linked selection, preflight and parallelism contracts provide starting points. validation_selection.py declares parallel_safe metadata; validate-artifact-lifecycle.py imports and calls validation_cache.py. Thus coordinated retirement is credible without claiming a complete caller inventory or existing suite-wide parallel safety.

Material impact: pass. The changed Test-separation direction and potential cache-removal runtime cost are disclosed. Removal requires replacements or explicit retirement with retained ownership and protection; historical record bytes/identities/judgments remain intact, and required current reliance basis must survive or reliance explicitly cease. No unsupported performance or deletion quota.
Vision alignment: aligned. Understandable current authority, protection and durable evidence support traceable/resumable engineering without a hosted runtime, new gate or mandatory test ledger.

Downstream authority and requested decision: pass. Exact dispositions, resource policy, compatibility, realization, sequencing and proof allocation remain with Design and Delivery. Adoption requires reviewed implementation and successful Verify. No required correction or recommended proposal edit.
Evidence remained bounded to the complete proposal, standing authority and its cited current models/contracts/code; no project-map reliance because the proposal records its pre-v3-runtime limitation.
summary: A coherent combined validation direction with required protection-preserving cleanup is sufficiently bounded and feasible for Design.
